meta.note: Alex, via Michael Don Petersen (2026-11-03, S30), confirms Elmer's parents were Hans Peter Petersen and Maren Sophia (Jensen; Mary on the 1900 census). Denmark parish is still unverified; immigration 1884 and birthplace Denmark (country only) stay as on the 1900 census. Hans Peter and Maren had 8 children: 1910 census mother of 7, 7 living (S28), plus Olga M. born after that census (S29). Rudolph Hans and the 1900 son Hans O. are probably the same person; the middle initial is unexplained. Find a Grave is secondary unless backed by MNHS or the census. Living people: only what Alex shared.
